description: Unsigned transactions for one credit risk action, checked against the contract for this wallet. Guarantor: cover (offer on a tranche at a yearly premium), withdraw_offer, collect (premium and interest), sell, unlist, buy, release (after the end), contest (a signed claim, with its bond). Credit company or firm: verify_entity (LEI and official domain, once a year). Credit company: publish (from its public anonymous loan file), close_offers, cancel, pay_premium, file_claim (loans in default from the loan file, with the public claim dossier), withdraw_claim, file_report (quarterly report), return_recovery, take_back_premium, replace_firm (when its firm was disowned). Verification firm: sign_engagement (with its EAS business attestation), attest, file_claim (signed at once), sign_claim, refuse_claim, sign_report. Juror: vote (hidden: keep your salt), reveal. Anyone: pay_claim, resolve, end. To be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet; nothing is signed or sent by this server.

attestation.description: Id of the EAS entity attestation issued to this wallet by a recognized verifier, obtained with verify_entity (publish, sign_engagement)

criteriaUri.description: Public address of the lending criteria, optional (publish)

defaultDays.description: Days unpaid that make a loan a default (publish)

domain.description: Official domain of the company, whose certificate names it and which publishes /.well-known/sjothr.json (verify_entity)

firm.description: Address of an eligible verification firm (publish, replace_firm), listed as verifiedFirms by sjothr_tribunal

firstLossPercent.description: Share of the loan book the company keeps first, in percent (publish)

hash.description: keccak256 of the same document's bytes, 0x and 64 hex digits (file_claim, file_report, sign_engagement, attest)

lei.description: LEI of the company, active in the GLEIF register (verify_entity)

lendingPercent.description: Share of USDC guarantees CantorFi may lend, fixed for life (publish)

licence.description: Regulator and licence number of the credit company (attest)

loans.description: Loans of the claim: number in the loan file, total loss in USDC for this loan, first unpaid day YYYY-MM-DD (file_claim)

loansUri.description: Public HTTPS, IPFS or Arweave address of the anonymous loan file, CSV loan_id,principal_usdc,rate_bps,maturity,status (publish)

poolId.description: Portfolio id (every action on a portfolio)

positionId.description: Position id (collect, sell, unlist, buy, release)

premium.description: Yearly premium asked, in percent, for example 11.5 (cover)

salt.description: Secret 0x and 64 hex digits chosen by the juror, the same for vote and reveal (vote, reveal)

signature.description: The wallet's signature (personal_sign) of the statement returned by verify_entity without signature (verify_entity)

uphold.description: true: the claim is founded (vote, reveal)

uri.description: Public address of the claim dossier, the quarterly report or the engagement (file_claim, file_report, sign_engagement)

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send
